conditions.access: local .cache/corpus rasters, warm OS disk cache; fresh service for every trial
conditions.scope: Server-side newly visible tile completion, not browser animation/paint or WAN latency. Sessions keep downloaded tiles. Spatially offset concurrent tracks have natural overlap. No retries or cancelled requests. Python cache compressed per process; native uncompressed shared. RSS sums shared Python pages.
